assessments.reasoning: The language authors' official lua.org site identifies the resource as Lua 5.4 Reference Manual. Its introduction and design chapters were directly inspected at the registered edition URL. The independently downloaded full response SHA-256 matches the registered source revision. The section describes automatic collection and specifically lists strings and tables. The collector's operating boundary is objects owned by Lua. Reachability and finalization qualify when an object becomes eligible. The edition and object categories match. The wording leaves host allocations and exact collection timings outside scope. The manual's registry and finalizer cases qualify reachability and timing while preserving the automatic management description.

limitations: The rule concerns Lua-managed memory and gives no fixed collection time. The manual qualifies reachability and finalization.
